title: Hi, I’m Basil.
text: Hi, I'm Basil. This is a prototype for teachers to explore and make their own. I said Tania couldn't easily turn Career Empire into something Curios teachers could adapt. Well, here we are!

title: Keep. Clear. Repurpose.
text: Her prompts were simple: keep the world, avatars, buildings and characters; remove the careers content; and leave the original untouched. Tania spent weeks building Career Empire, then hours cloning it for Curios.

title: Keep. Clear. Repurpose.
text: The teacher tools, branding, app rooms and testing came afterwards.

title: Walk in. Open an app.
text: Walk into the ArtQuest + Loopy Tunes centre. Walk up to either desktop PC and press E to open the app shown on its monitor. Archon Engine is in the Learning Hall. Return to Curios brings you back.

title: Make it your own.
text: Try Teacher setup in the top bar: change names, conversations and app links, then preview your ideas. Download the settings for ICT when you're ready to publish. New activities and game rules still need development.

title: Reuse. Repurpose. Recycle.
text: Reuse. Repurpose. Recycle. Curios: learning without limits. Apparently, you can teach an old NPC new tricks.

title: A world we can reshape.
text: This prototype is for teachers. It shows how we can modularise the software we're creating, repurpose it for different uses, and add or remove the parts we want.

title: Build once. Keep experimenting.
text: Once the world is built, customisation becomes much easier. The final additions were the Curios Lunar Lab building and a moon rover you can drive.

title: Prototypes and possibilities.
text: It's all still a prototype: kicking around ideas, having fun and experimenting with what's possible. What could you add, swap or take out for your own use?

title: Hop in. Let’s explore!
text: Hop in the rover and let's take a drive to the Curios Lunar Lab. Who knows what could come next? Maybe one day I'll hop into a rocket and blast off into the Mooniverse!
